description: The Drogenapstoren at Zutphen is the former Saltpoort, a square brick tower of 1444-1446 with octagonal corner turrets and a tall octagonal lantern. The high spire with dormers is the nineteenth-century crown, so the tower is shown complete. The old passage was bricked up, and no street is seen through it. It is partly cloudy, about 9.9°C, with wind near 7.9 km/h and cloud cover about 57%. The Berkelpoort is a different gate and is not this tower.
